title: Rail takes the strain on the Orvan to Ravik grain run

facts.subject: Orvan wheat
facts.statement: Grain traffic on the Ravik Rail Link has risen sharply since Orvan's sea corridor agreement lapsed, but operators warn that the line cannot absorb the lost sea volumes.

source_ref.text_snippet: Grain traffic on the Ravik Rail Link has risen sharply since Orvan's sea corridor agreement lapsed, but operators warn that the line cannot absorb the lost sea volumes.

facts.subject: rail tariffs
facts.statement: Rail tariffs have risen with demand.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rail tariffs have risen with demand.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: The operator says the extra traffic has been handled without a formal priority scheme.

source_ref.text_snippet: The operator says the extra traffic has been handled without a formal priority scheme.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: The line's operator says priority is being given to contracted cargoes.
